items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok 4.6: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents at Same Price as 4.5
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok 4.6：長程 Agent 前沿智能，價格與 4.5 相同
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok 4.6 on August 12 as a significant improvement over Grok 4.5, focused on long-running agents, interactive and visual work, and complex multi-step tasks. It matches GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and is available now in the API, Cursor, and Grok Build at $2/$6 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 於 8 月 12 日宣布 Grok 4.6，相較 4.5 有明顯提升，專注長程 agent、互動與視覺工作及複雜多步驟任務。它在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上與 GPT-5.6 Sol 持平，現已於 API、Cursor 與 Grok Build 提供，價格為每百萬 token $2/$6。
items_flat.analysis_en: This keeps xAI competitive on the price-performance frontier while targeting the agentic workloads that drive real productivity. Independent long-horizon evaluations versus closed models and the upcoming Grok 4.7 (with SpaceX data) will show whether the gap to the absolute frontier continues to close.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓 xAI 在性價比前沿保持競爭力，並鎖定真正帶來生產力的 agent 工作負載。與閉源模型的獨立長程評估，以及即將到來的 Grok 4.7（加入 SpaceX 數據）將決定它與絕對前沿的差距是否持續縮小。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 在 Grok 4.5 基礎上，特別聚焦長程 agent 以及更有野心的互動與視覺工作。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches SL2T: Sign-Language-to-Text Model Powers ASL Input on Pixel 11
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T：手語轉文字模型，支援 Pixel 11 ASL 輸入
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced SL2T, a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text model trained on more than 100,000 hours of data across 50+ sign languages. Starting today it powers American Sign Language-to-English dictation in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T，這是一個大規模多語手語轉文字模型，訓練資料超過 10 萬小時、涵蓋 50 多種手語。即日起在 Pixel 11 的 Gboard 與 Live Transcribe 提供美式手語轉英文聽寫功能。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves sign-language AI from research demos into everyday consumer devices for the first time. Scalability to more languages and devices, plus real-world accuracy on complex signing and one-handed use, will determine broader impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 首次把手語 AI 從研究展示推進到日常消費裝置。能否擴展到更多語言與裝置，以及在複雜手語與單手操作上的真實準確度，將決定其廣泛影響。
items_flat.quote: SL2T is our breakthrough sign language-to-text model powering new features for Deaf and hard of hearing users on Android.
items_flat.quote_zh: SL2T 是我們的突破性手語轉文字模型，為 Android 上的聾人與聽障使用者提供新功能。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Models Now Available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak 網路安全模型現已在 Amazon Bedrock 提供
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made its Daybreak Blue (GPT-5.6 Sol with defensive safeguards) and Daybreak Red (purpose-trained GPT-5.6 Cyber) models available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock. The models support authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and security testing within existing AWS environments.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Daybreak Blue（附防禦安全措施的 GPT-5.6 Sol）與 Daybreak Red（專為網路安全訓練的 GPT-5.6 Cyber）提供給符合資格的 Amazon Bedrock 客戶。模型支援授權漏洞研究、漏洞驗證與安全測試，並可在現有 AWS 環境中使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extends frontier cyber capabilities into the cloud platforms enterprises already trust, potentially accelerating defender adoption while keeping strict access controls. Real-world effectiveness and the breadth of eligible customers remain to be seen.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把前沿網路安全能力延伸到企業已信任的雲平台，可能加速防禦方採用，同時維持嚴格存取控制。真實世界效果與符合資格客戶的範圍仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing the next step in our work with AWS: making Daybreak capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布與 AWS 合作的下一步：透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供 Daybreak 能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Report: Enterprise AI Shifts from Assistance to Agentic Execution
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 報告：企業 AI 從輔助轉向 Agent 執行
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published data showing enterprise usage is becoming more agentic: Codex accounted for 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers as of June. Frontier firms now generate 8.3× more tokens per user than typical firms.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布數據顯示企業使用正變得更 agent 化：截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合計輸出 token 的 64%。前沿企業每位使用者產生的 token 已是一般企業的 8.3 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provides rare quantitative evidence of the agent transition inside real companies. The widening frontier-firm gap suggests early movers are compounding advantages that later adopters may struggle to close.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 提供企業內部 agent 轉型的罕見量化證據。前沿企業與一般企業的差距擴大，顯示早期採用者正在累積後進者可能難以追趕的優勢。
items_flat.quote: Enterprise AI is shifting from assistance to execution.
items_flat.quote_zh: 企業 AI 正從輔助轉向執行。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Turns Claude in Chrome Side Panel into Full Claude Cowork Session
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Claude Chrome 側邊欄升級為完整 Claude Cowork 工作階段
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that the Claude in Chrome side panel is now a full Claude Cowork session. Conversations are saved to history, skills and connectors work in the browser, and tasks started in a tab can continue on desktop, web or mobile apps.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude in Chrome 側邊欄現已成為完整的 Claude Cowork 工作階段。對話會儲存至歷史紀錄，技能與連接器可在瀏覽器中使用，從分頁開始的任務可在桌面、網頁或手機 App 繼續。
items_flat.analysis_en: Closes a practical workflow gap by making browser-based multi-step work persistent across devices. Adoption will depend on how reliably Claude acts inside real websites and how enterprises manage the new surface area.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過讓瀏覽器多步驟工作在不同裝置間持續，補上實用工作流程缺口。採用程度將取決於 Claude 在真實網站上的可靠程度，以及企業如何管理這塊新介面。
items_flat.quote: The Claude in Chrome side panel is now a Claude Cowork session. Conversations are saved to your history, your skills and connectors work in the browser, and a task you start in a tab can be finished on the Claude desktop, web, and mobile apps.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude in Chrome 側邊欄現在是 Claude Cowork 工作階段。對話會儲存到歷史紀錄，技能與連接器可在瀏覽器運作，從分頁開始的任務可在桌面、網頁與手機 App 完成。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Releases Open Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: Efficient 30B MoE for Agentic Workloads
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：高效 30B MoE，專為 Agent 工作負載設計
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (3B active) optimized for high-volume specialized tasks in always-on multi-agent systems. It claims up to 4× faster output speed and is fully open with weights available on Hugging Face and other platforms.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是 300 億參數的專家混合模型（活躍參數 30 億），針對常駐多 agent 系統中的高量專業任務優化。聲稱輸出速度最高可快 4 倍，並完全開源，權重已上架 Hugging Face 等平台。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reinforces the open-weights efficiency trend for on-device and edge agents. Post-training flexibility and real-world agent harness performance will determine whether it becomes a default specialized executor in multi-model systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強化開源權重在端側與邊緣 agent 的效率趨勢。後訓練彈性與真實 agent 框架表現，將決定它是否成為多模型系統中的預設專業執行器。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is expanding its Nemotron 3 model family with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, the highest-efficiency model in its class for long-running agentic AI workloads.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天 NVIDIA 擴展 Nemotron 3 系列，推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，是同類中針對長程 agent AI 工作負載效率最高的模型。
